ctx.x: You were talking about Eddie Edwards, he was smart in organizing, right? Well, he knew the trouble of Tom Ed in Chicago, see? Tom was up there, the band was going so good and attracting so much attention that the band leaders would try to break up Tom's band by trying to offer one man a little bit more money, see? And some of them would quit Tom, and Tom would come back to the laws and get someone else, that's the way it was. So, in order to avoid that trouble, Eddie Edwards incorporated the band, see?
Tom got his way out to home.
